Module 1: Program Discovery & Crawler Engine

Autonomous Federal & State Program Scanning

An autonomous background daemon designed to monitor and index changes across official federal and Texas state small business portals:

  • SBA Program Notices: Tracks CFR updates on 13 CFR § 124 (8(a) thresholds, mentor-protégé joint ventures).
  • Texas Comptroller CMBL Scraper: Monitors NIGP commodity code solicitations for 910-39 (Janitorial) and 962-58 (Post-Construction).
  • Regional Diversity Updates: Tracks NCTRCA, City of Dallas, and DFW Airport MWBE inclusion mandates.
Module 2: Qualification Matching & Eligibility Engine

Automated Error-Proof Eligibility Review

Automated verification of HWB corporate data against legal qualification criteria before any application is submitted:

  • Personal Net Worth Floor: Confirms Form 413 personal assets remain under $850,000 (excluding primary home & equity).
  • Two-Year Operating Runway Audit: Validates filed 2025 business tax returns and calculates waiver readiness score.
  • 51% Sovereign Control Verification: Scans the Texas LLC Operating Agreement for negative veto covenants.
Module 3: Verified Legal Sources & Statute Index

Verifiable Legal Grounding

Direct legal citations hardcoded into the SigmaFidelity™ compliance index to replace assumptions with verified legal truth:

  • Federal 8(a) Regulations: 13 CFR § 124.101 through § 124.108 (Social & Economic Disadvantage, Runway Waiver).
  • Texas Discretionary Purchasing: Texas Local Government Code § 252.0215 (Mandatory 2-HUB rotation under $50,000).
  • City of Dallas BID Policy: Council Resolution 20-0441 (Mandatory 23.8% M/WBE subcontracting goal).
Module 4: Government API Integration Hub

Direct Government API Processing

Direct machine-to-machine integrations to feed live opportunities into the Sales Desk and Operations Dashboard:

  • SAM.gov Entity Management API: Live sync of HWB’s CAGE code, UEI status, and SDB self-certification.
  • USAspending REST API v2: Ingests expiring federal custodial awards across Texas military and civilian hubs.
  • B2Gnow Diversity Compliance API: Live monitoring of prime contractor subcontracting compliance on City of Dallas contracts.

                     Search Tips & Filters
                
        
                
        
                    Use boolean words, isolate exact phrases, and combine choices across all Operations desks.
                
        
            
        
            
        
        
        
        
            
            
        
                
        CONNECTING CONDITIONS (AND)
        
                Plano and "Child Care Center"  or  Plano AND Daycare
                
        Finds records that match both terms. Works with everyday lowercase "and" as well as uppercase "AND".
        
            
        

            
            
        
                
        ALTERNATIVE CHOICES (OR)
        
                Plano OR Frisco  or  Daycare OR "Learning Center"
                
        Finds records that match either one of your choices.
        
            
        

            
            
        
                
        LOGICAL GROUPING (PARENTHESES)
        
                (Plano OR Frisco) and "Child Care Center"
                
        Use parentheses to bundle options together before applying additional filters.
        
            
        

            
            
        
                
        NEGATIVE EXCLUSIONS (NOT / MINUS)
        
                Plano NOT Church  or  Plano -Church
                
        Hides specific records containing that word or phrase.
        
            
        

            
            
        
                
        EXACT PHRASE
        
                "North Texas"
                
        Finds literal text matches within quotes.
        
            
        

            
            
        
                
        WILDCARDS
        
                Dist*
                
        The asterisk matches any following characters.
        
            
        

            
            
        
                
        FIELD TARGETING & ASSIGNED REPS
        
                Beabe Wiley  or  rep:Wiley  or  city:Plano industry:Medical
                
        Type a rep's full name (e.g., Beabe Wiley), use the 👤 All Owners dropdown, or target specific columns directly (city, industry, status, sqf, value, contact, rep, owner:unassigned).
        
            
        

            
            
        
                
        AMERICAN DATES
        
                04/10/2026 or 04/10/*
                
        The system automatically flips American dates to match the database engine.
        
            
        

            
            
        
                
        NUMERIC PRECISION & RANGES
        
                sqf:>=10000 sqf:<20000  or  value:>50000
                
        Use >, <, >=, <=, = to isolate contract values, areas, or scores.
